## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes on my machine.
- [ ] New rules have tests, and every new guard has a test that shows it fails on a bad input.
- [ ] A changeset (`pnpm changeset`), if users will notice the change.
- [ ] No coverage floor lowered, no lint rule switched off, no check skipped.
- [ ] Test data is made up. No personal data, no real company data.
